metadata.title: Momentum Stocks Are Making a Comeback

content.text:
CONCLUDED
8 hours ago
Momentum Stocks Are Making a Comeback
The hottest trades of 2026 are roaring back to start August.
After a brutal month of July that saw the iShares Semiconductor ETF fall more than 20%, investors are piling back into the most popular names of the year. Sandisk, the top performer in the S&P 500 this year, rose more than 7%, while Marvell Technology popped nearly 12% on Tuesday. Both were among the best performers in the S&P 500 in early trading.
We recently noted in the Barron’s Investor Circle newsletter the market was primed to shift back to momentum stocks, a factor that focuses on buying winning stocks in the belief they will keep on winning. With overextended positioning cleared out in July, Wall Street analysts have argued investors were likely to shift back to areas like chip stocks and other AI infrastructure trades given the earnings outlook has only strengthened over the past month.
